data.title: Welfare card rules rejigged
data.description: The Finance Ministry has revised the eligibility criteria for the state welfare card scheme, allowing owners of older vehicles to retain their benefits while extending the deadline for unsuccessful applicants to appeal until Sept 20.

data.title: Albania police teargas protesters against Trump-linked resort
data.description: TIRANA (ALBANIA) - Police used tear gas and water cannon on Thursday against protesters outside the parliament in Albania, where a tourism project linked to the Trump family has sparked outrage.

data.title: US panel says to loosen restrictions on popular peptide despite safety concerns
data.description: NEW YORK - A US review panel on Thursday recommended loosening restrictions on the much hyped peptide BPC-157, voting that specialized pharmacies be allowed to produce it despite alarm bells from medical experts over safety concerns.

data.title: Fields medal awarded to four young mathematicians
data.description: PHILADELPHIA - The Fields medal, known as the Nobel prize of mathematics, was awarded Thursday to four people -- two Chinese citizens, one American and one Canadian.

data.title: Confusing Thai Time-Counting Method: Why "2" Means 8 PM in Thailand
data.description: If you’ve ever had a conversation with a Thai person, you might have encountered our unique way of telling time.

data.title: Retail giants turn mall revamps into Bangkok’s new property battleground
data.description: Thailand’s leading retail and property groups are investing billions of baht in mall revamps and mixed-use projects, turning ageing shopping centres into lifestyle, cultural and food landmarks as mass transit and rising land values reshape Bangkok’s key districts.

data.title: RESAM calls for new city plan to end mandatory parking for condos near rail stations
data.description: RESAM says scrapping compulsory parking requirements for condominiums near electric train stations could cut urban housing prices, encourage mass-transit use and support more affordable city living.

data.title: Top 5 rail-line land price rises revealed, Green Line Khu Khot-Lam Luk Ka leads
data.description: REIC data shows land prices along mass transit routes continued to climb in the second quarter of 2026, led by the Green Line extension from Khu Khot to Lam Luk Ka.
